_help: groups: lesson start per group, 6 times, index 0 = lesson 1. Times without a zone are Asia/Tashkent (+05:00). liveOverride: null or a lesson number 1-6 that pins the live lesson. liveDays: how long lesson 6 stays live. release: optional per-lesson, per-part opening time: "open", "+0h" / "+3h" / "-2d" / "+30m" (relative to that group's lesson start; lesson 0 is relative to lesson 1's start) or an absolute "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM". Parts: slides, amaliyot, kit, vazifa, prep. Defaults: prep "open", everything else "+0h". Example: "release": {"1": {"vazifa": "+3h"}, "6": {"kit": "2026-12-26T09:00"}}. A lesson with no parts yet opens at its start time. Dates to follow: set a group to null ("shanba": null) while its dates are not decided. Lessons 1-6 then stay locked for that group (and for students with no group), whatever release says; lesson 0 (prep) stays open. To announce dates, replace null with 6 increasing times.
